value_updates.hero_headline: The Easiest Way to Create a Personalized Vehicle Sales Page
value_updates.hero_body_copy:
Use your phone to record a walkaround video, add photos, a personal note, and helpful dealership links. In under a minute, DriveReel creates a professional vehicle sales page you can text or email to your customer.

Everything they need is in one place, including your video, vehicle photos, Carfax, window sticker, quote, trade appraisal, and more. No editing software. No computer. Just a simple tool built for busy automotive salespeople.
